current_article.title: Unlock the last part of the door as Helioptile makes its debut in the electrifying Power Plant event — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
Unlock the last part of the door as Helioptile makes its debut in the electrifying Power Plant event
Power Plant Event
Team GO Rocket Strikes!
Power Plant Event
Wednesday, January 19, 2022, at 10:00 a.m. to Tuesday, February 1, 2022, at 10:00 a.m. local time
The Season of Heritage Story Continues!
Spark’s intuition leads him to believe that the final mechanism of the door requires Electric-type Pokémon to power it. Work with Spark to catch Pokémon as he makes progress toward unlocking the final mechanism of the mysterious door located at the historical cave site. In this event inspired by the power plants found in the Kanto and Kalos regions, you’ll be able to catch Pokémon like Magnemite, Voltorb, and Helioptile!
In the shadows, it seems that a nefarious force has also caught wind of the door and the power that lies beyond it…
Catch up on the story so far on the Season of Heritage web page .
Pokémon Debuts
Helioptile and Heliolisk make their debuts in Pokémon GO!
Helioptile can evolve into Heliolisk with 50 Helioptile Candy and a Sun Stone.
Helioptile
Heliolisk

Team GO Rocket Strikes!
Beginning Monday, January 24, 2022, at 12:00 a.m. local time until Sunday, January 30, 2022 at 10:00 a.m. local time.
The Season of Heritage Story Continues!
Just as Spark has obtained enough Electric-type Pokémon, he’s hit with another flash of intuition that something bad is coming. His suspicions are confirmed after he finds a crumpled piece of paper detailing some of Team GO Rocket’s plans for a take-over! He notifies Professor Willow and the team leaders, and they quickly rush out to take on the villains!
As they continue to deal with Team GO Rocket, Spark can’t help but feel that there’s more to this take-over than meets the eye…
Catch up on the story so far on the Season of Heritage web page .

Shadow Pokémon
Team GO Rocket has been busy in the shadows. Team GO Rocket Grunts as well as their leaders—Cliff, Sierra, and Arlo—are using different Shadow Pokémon. Help Spark, Blanche, and Candela overcome their adversaries and rescue the Shadow Pokémon.
In addition, Team GO Rocket has also changed the following Pokémon to Shadow Pokémon. Defeat Team GO Rocket Grunts to save them!
Shadow Voltorb
Shadow Chikorita
Shadow Cyndaquil
Shadow Totodile
Shadow Whismur
Shadow Hippopotas
Event Bonuses
Team GO Rocket will be appearing more frequently at PokéStops and in balloons.
You can use a Charged TM to help a Shadow Pokémon forget the Charged Attack Frustration.
